title: AR Showcase
intro: Try ten featured destinations in this AR demo, wherever you are. On-site AR unlocks when you enter the destination’s visit area.
openHint: Open this destination in the AR Showcase
readyHint: You can try this demo wherever you are. In the app, AR opens when you visit the destination.
preflight: Find a bright spot with room to turn. Hold your phone upright and move it slowly to explore with your camera.
loadFailed: This destination could not be loaded. Try again, or choose another destination.
unavailable: Open the showcase from Profile or Settings after signing in or continuing as a guest.
passportHint: Start AR to collect a demo stamp. These stamps stay in this showcase and reset when you leave.
expired: This AR session has ended. Choose the destination again to start a new experience.
